#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;
using INT = long long;
const int MOD = 1e9+7;

int power(int base, int exp, int modulus, int result=1) {
    for(; exp; exp>>=1, base=(INT)base*base%modulus) if(exp & 1) result = (INT)result * base % modulus;
    return result;
}

const int MAXN = 1<<7;
int matrix_p[MAXN][MAXN];
int matrix_pro[MAXN][MAXN];
int bit_count[MAXN];
INT q_array[MAXN][MAXN];
int n;
int id_array[MAXN];
vector<int> groups[MAXN];
map<pair<int, INT>, int> memo;

inline void add_mod(int &a, int b) {a+=b; if(a>=MOD) a -= MOD;}

int compute(int current, INT state) {
    if(state == 0) return 0;
    if(current == n) return 1;
    if(memo.count({current, state})) return memo[{current, state}];
    int answer = 0;
    for(int subset=1; subset<(1<<n); ++subset) {
        INT new_state = 0;
        for(int k=0; k<(int)groups[current].size(); ++k) {
            if(!(state & (1LL<<k))) continue;
            int cur = groups[current][k];
            int nxt = subset - (subset & cur);
            new_state |= q_array[cur][nxt];
        }
        add_mod(answer, (INT)matrix_pro[current][subset] * compute(current+1, new_state) % MOD);
    }
    return memo[{current, state}] = answer;
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("in.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("out.out", "w", stdout);
#endif
    scanf("%d", &n);
    int inv_100 = power(100, MOD-2, MOD);
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for(int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            scanf("%d", matrix_p[i]+j);
            matrix_p[i][j] = (INT)matrix_p[i][j] * inv_100 % MOD;
        }
    }
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for(int j=0; j<(1<<n); j++) {
            matrix_pro[i][j] = 1;
            for(int k=0; k<n; k++) {
                if((j>>k)&1) {
                    matrix_pro[i][j] = (INT)matrix_pro[i][j] * matrix_p[i][k] % MOD;
                } else {
                    matrix_pro[i][j] = (INT)matrix_pro[i][j] * (MOD+1 - matrix_p[i][k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for(int i=0; i<(1<<n); i++) bit_count[i] = __builtin_popcount(i);
    for(int i=0; i<(1<<n); i++) {
        groups[bit_count[i]].push_back(i);
        id_array[i] = (int)groups[bit_count[i]].size() - 1;
    }
    for(int i=0; i<(1<<n); i++) {
        for(int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if(!((i>>j)&1)) q_array[i][1<<j] = 1LL<<id_array[i|(1<<j)];
        }
        for(int j=0; j<(1<<n); j++) {
            q_array[i][j] = q_array[i][j&-j] | q_array[i][j ^ (j&-j)];
        }
    }
    cout << compute(0, 1) << endl;
